ValidationRule.description: uAssistant Cannot Change uAssist Status if the 'Assigned uAssistant' field is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Assigned_uAssistant__c ), ISCHANGED( uAssist_Status__c ), CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, "uAssist") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please assign this to a uAssistant before changing the uAssist Status.
